description: Breast Cancer Screening — synthetic patient test fixtures

patients.label: denom_in_numerator_met
patients.description: Woman age 62 with mammogram CPT 77067 documented 14 months ago — should be IN denom and IN numerator
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Age 62 is within 50-74 range; mammogram CPT 77067 within 27-month window satisfies BCS numerator

patients.label: denom_in_numerator_unmet
patients.description: Woman age 58 — no mammogram in prior 27 months
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Age 58 is within 50-74 range; no mammogram CPT in 27-month window means numerator not met

patients.label: denom_out_too_young
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Age 45 < 50 minimum; patient not eligible for BCS denominator

patients.label: denom_out_too_old
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Age 76 > 74 maximum; patient not eligible for BCS denominator

patients.label: denom_out_male
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: BCS is restricted to female members; male patient not in denominator

patients.label: exclusion_bilateral_mastectomy
patients.description: Woman age 55 with bilateral mastectomy history (Z90.13) — should be excluded
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Z90.13 = acquired absence of bilateral breasts; NCQA spec excludes these women from BCS denominator. MVP does not yet implement this exclusion (known gap).

patients.label: denom_in_hcpcs_mammogram
patients.description: Woman age 51 with mammogram via HCPCS G0202
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: HCPCS G0202 (screening mammography) qualifies for BCS numerator within 27-month window

patients.label: denom_in_mammogram_outside_window
patients.description: Woman age 68 — last mammogram was 30 months ago (outside 27-month window)
patients.ncqa_spec_rationale: Mammogram more than 27 months before Dec 31 does not qualify; gap is open
